item.satisfying_weapons.desc.unlock_crit: {FF5555}To unlock, combine with an identical weapon of any level using Upgrader!
item.satisfying_weapons.firework_sword.s: Hitting a mob grants 1_stack of {ED1D6D}Festivity{AAAAAA}, up to 5_stacks. While in the air, press jump to consume 3_stacks of {ED1D6D}Festivity{AAAAAA} and do a {F29C2A}Firework Jump{AAAAAA}; then, sneak to do a plunge attack.
Plunge attack damage increases by 25% and is further increased by 15% for each mob in its current radius. Max damage increase is_100%.
For each mob damaged by a plunge attack, recover 1_stack of {ED1D6D}Festivity{AAAAAA}. Max 2_stacks per plunge attack.
For each mob damaged by a plunge attack, recover 1_HP.
{ED1D6D}Festivity{AAAAAA} can now go up to 10_stacks. Also, {ED1D6D}Festivity{AAAAAA} recovered from {EEEE66}Level_3{AAAAAA} is no longer limited to 2_stacks per plunge attack.
item.satisfying_weapons.toy_bow.skill_de: Shoots {1E90FF}Toy Arrows{AAAAAA} that apply {F123DE}Birthday Party{AAAAAA} to the target hit. While the target has an active {F123DE}Birthday Party{AAAAAA}, it will cause all non-friendly mobs to attack it.
Greatly increases accuracy and range of {1E90FF}Toy Arrows{AAAAAA}. Also, there is a 50%_chance to keep an arrow after shooting.

When {F123DE}Birthday Party{AAAAAA} is applied, {F53C0F}Birthday Gift{AAAAAA} appears above the target’s head. After the {F123DE}Birthday Party{AAAAAA} ends, or the target dies, {F53C0F}Birthday Gift{AAAAAA} will fall down and explode.
Entities with {F123DE}Birthday Party{AAAAAA} are slowed down and receive 15%_more damage.

Hitting a {F53C0F}Birthday Gift{AAAAAA} with a {1E90FF}Toy Arrow{AAAAAA} will cause it to explode and fire 5_identical {1E90FF}Toy Arrows{AAAAAA} in random directions, prioritizing other mobs as targets.
item.satisfying_weapons.sword_of_dying_s: Right click - Black Hole, costs 2 durability, lasts 1.5 s, cooldown 3 s
Durability cost 2 -> 1, if sneaking, Black Hole transfers all items and EXP to you inventory
Effect: fall damage +50%, all other damage +20%
Cooldown decreased by 1 s, affected mobs have a chance to drop equipment
Can ignore cooldown by sacrificing 2 HP, colliding 2 Black Holes creates an explosion
advancement.satisfying_weapons.root.desc: Kill monsters, craft wishes, collect weapons
